Fictional training input: An unnamed fictional knowledge-work organization with 2,000 employees; Operations seeks better support throughput and Sales seeks better meeting readiness.
Learner use / deliberate gap: Use no real customer name, logo or live confidential data.
Assessor guidance: All facts belong to the simulation, not a Glean customer reference.

Fictional training input: COO wants improved support capacity while maintaining quality this quarter; CRO wants more consistent preparation. Sponsor asks for a decision-ready value case, not a general AI experiment.
Learner use / deliberate gap: Draft separate outcome hypotheses; do not automatically combine overlapping value.
Assessor guidance: Sponsor will challenge attribution and ask how capacity is used.

Fictional training input: COO is the simulated executive sponsor; Support Operations owns the first metric; a technical champion coordinates platform owners; procurement/signature process is not yet known.
Learner use / deliberate gap: Map sponsor, champion, metric/data owner and procurement gap.
Assessor guidance: Do not give the learner procurement dates unless asked; answer unknown, must validate.

Fictional training input: Support uses an ITSM platform, an approved knowledge repository and collaboration messages. Sales uses CRM, meeting notes and knowledge documents. Current connector/permission behavior has not been verified.
Learner use / deliberate gap: Do not infer product connector support or data access from generic system labels.
Assessor guidance: Technical owner says feasibility and scope need review.

Fictional training input: Support workflow scope: 200 potential users, two events per active user per workday, 240 workdays/year. These are supplied training assumptions, not measured deployment data.
Learner use / deliberate gap: Adoption is separate from addressable population.
Assessor guidance: Use explicit event/day and annualization units.

Fictional training input: Read case 2 min; find approved guidance 8 min; consult colleague 3 min; draft response 5 min; review/send 2 min. All durations are interview estimates of active work, not measured baselines.
Learner use / deliberate gap: Total map is 20 active min; model only the 8-min avoidable knowledge-friction burden in ROI Lab, not all 20.
Assessor guidance: Learner must not remove read/review controls or credit all steps as eliminated.

Fictional training input: Some cases wait one business day for specialist input; no frequency or monetary impact is known.
Learner use / deliberate gap: Keep elapsed delay separate; do not monetize as a day of labor saved.
Assessor guidance: Ask for frequency/causal impact and propose measurement.

Fictional training input: Grounded access to approved guidance may reduce search friction and support drafting. Human source review, final response approval and escalation remain. Exact future timing is unknown.
Learner use / deliberate gap: Use a validation test and do not claim guaranteed automation.
Assessor guidance: Accept plausible narrowed scope with explicit dependencies.

Fictional training input: Adoption 50%; avoidable burden 8 min/event; removable fraction 60%; relevant coverage 80%; recapture 25%; loaded rate $60/hour; risk haircut 10%; first-year all-in cost $30,000.
Learner use / deliberate gap: These factors illustrate explicit modeling, not approved Glean defaults/pricing or actual benefits.
Assessor guidance: Validate raw-burden versus measured-saving meaning; prevent duplicate discounts.

Fictional training input: Support manager proposes redeploying freed capacity toward backlog reduction. No headcount reduction, cancelled spend or avoided hire has been approved.
Learner use / deliberate gap: Classify benefits as directional capacity, not cash savings.
Assessor guidance: Recapture is uncertain and should be measured via a concrete reallocation plan.

Fictional training input: 100 potential users; prepare for a customer meeting by reviewing CRM 10 min, finding notes 10 min, locating relevant content 15 min and drafting brief 10 min. Frequency and comparable baseline sample are unknown.
Learner use / deliberate gap: Second workflow map; no monetization until frequency/adoption/overlap are validated.
Assessor guidance: Do not add a sales benefit total to support without adequate assumptions.

Fictional training input: Autonomous refund approval, perfect cross-system BI joins and a custom legacy-source agent are requested. Authorization, deterministic data path and custom connector feasibility are unverified.
Learner use / deliberate gap: Park or phase based on effort and risk; ask diagnostic questions.
Assessor guidance: No product claim that these are supported or unsupported universally; scope depends on verification.

Fictional training input: No standardized pre-rollout timing sample or system-outcome comparison exists. Support owner can arrange a sample but has not agreed dates or targets.
Learner use / deliberate gap: Propose cohort, period, metric definition, quality guardrail and owner.
Assessor guidance: Target values remain proposals until simulated sponsor agreement.

Fictional training input: The sponsor asks: Why not just give us a pilot? How does saved time turn into a business result? What evidence will replace estimates?
Learner use / deliberate gap: Demonstrate value, validation and objection-handling judgment.
Assessor guidance: Ask all three questions; score answer honesty and decision quality, not sales pressure.

Fictional training input: Prepare A01–A20 as applicable, including first-wave use case log/matrix, two current/future map pairs, three-scenario model, metric cards, readout, recommendation, MAP, recap and handoff.
Learner use / deliberate gap: One versioned submission manifest; 8–10-minute executive readout plus short facilitation segment.
Assessor guidance: Core omissions trigger G04; internal images and real customer stories not required.

Fictional training input: Online: recorded segment and submitted artifacts. In person: same artifacts and live observations. Use the same rubric, thresholds and critical gates.
Learner use / deliberate gap: Accept accessible written/live alternative as appropriate without removing the competence requirement.
Assessor guidance: Have a second reviewer calibrate borderline scores; store outcome under approved privacy policy.
